comment: Plugins statically merged into librime for the XCFramework artifacts. Entries without "local" are git submodules whose pinned revisions are the gitlinks recorded in the repository index (.gitmodules); this manifest only describes how to build and verify each one. Entries with "local": true live in this repository and are covered by its own LICENSE. The build reads this file to set RIME_PLUGINS, apply per-plugin patches, verify licenses, and report metadata.
